assessment: This important study reveals that disrupting fatty acid metabolism in macrophages significantly restricts the growth of Mycobacterium tuberculosis, showing that impaired lipid processing triggers various antimicrobial responses. Overall, the approach is robust utilizing CRISPR-Cas9 knockout of multiple genes involved in lipid metabolism that yielded convincing data. This work highlights how host lipid metabolism affects the ability of tubercle bacilli to thrive intracellularly, pointing to potential new therapeutic targets.
